name: Tapped Target Survivor
body:
You earned a perfect score as a caster in the tapped target tag course at Diamond Academy.

Prerequisite: Diamond Academy Graduate trait, caster level 2nd

Benefit: When you successfully use the aid another special attack in combat, you receive a +2 bonus to AC until the beginning of your next turn.
